title: The Ambered Irons
description: Watch results for the Ambered Irons — a reach of golden amber, deep drowns, and the DaWheh-Whe.

prompts.text: A group of Wheh-Whe sit and braid rope for an upcoming rite of passage.
A maternal DaWheh-Whe approaches one of the crew and teaches them how to make honey rocks.
Prismatic webbing has gummed up the engine gears; some chrysalises must have hatched.
The call of the Golden Mother is heard through your sails and soul, making a request.
Beams of sunlight cast from a swarm of sunbeam bats as they hunt bioluminescent moths.
The smell of Nectar Falls brings you to the railings to watch as you fly over its golden thunder.
A Soulful Tigers ship floats by on its way to mine gemstones, prompting a cheerful exchange.
A grove of Rooted stand and watch you silently before something gains their attention.
You see DaWheh-Whe painted in bright colours for an upcoming Utaka game — a contest of sport and endurance against another team.
The Silent Bloom overtakes a ship in the darkness; now spots of bloom show up underneath you.
The ship is asked to stop by a Wilted, to allow right of way for a burial procession.
You watch as a group of Wilted reanimate a large skeleton into a Rooted beast of burden.
Thermals from the Dredge carry up salt-laden winds and begin coating the ship.
A shadow beyond opaque strata seems to follow the ship before crashing outwards towards you.
Amber rain begins to fall; everything is golden glue.
Cargo labelled 'in sunlight only' gets some shade, and it begins blooming.
Some sunbeam bats find shelter in the ship's eaves, casting a warm glow like lanterns upon the deck.
The pollen of the Silent Bloom brings the crew comfort and rest, closure on the warm winds.
